headline: Talaat Moustafa Group Reports 12.5% Rise in Q3 Net Profit to EGP 5.06 Billion
summary: Egyptian real estate developer Talaat Moustafa Group reported a 12.5% increase in third-quarter net profit to EGP 5.06 billion. Revenue rose 24.7% to EGP 17.36 billion, supported by expanded residential property deliveries.
why: Talaat Moustafa Group is the largest publicly traded real estate developer in Egypt, constructing major master-planned community developments.

impacts.name: Talaat Moustafa Group Holding
impacts.why: Double-digit revenue and net profit growth strengthen shareholder earnings performance.
